summary: Payette NF summit lookout in the West Mountains near Cascade: a 1907 alidade platform with a log cabin, listed as abandoned; the 2022 Four Corners Fire burned the area around the peak.

facts.design: Alidade platform with a log cabin about 400 yards below the summit, at the spring
facts.status_note: Listed as abandoned with no date; no source we read says whether the platform or cabin remains.

access.note: Reached by a short hike from a trailhead; a 2023 trip report says you can drive within two miles of the summit.

visit.trail_note: From the trailhead, the Van Wyck ATV trail takes you the first mile and a half.

events.note: Alidade platform with a log cabin 400 yards below the summit, at the spring
Four Corners Fire ignited by lightning on August 13, 2022, west of Cascade Lake near Lookout Peak; a 2023 trip report says most of the surrounding area burned

corrections.why: The Forest Fire Lookout Association list gives the status as Abandoned for this platform; no source says the platform or cabin was removed.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Sources name the Payette National Forest alone or with the Boise National Forest; the record keeps Payette National Forest, which every source names.

notes_for_editor: Elevation is 7813 ft on firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts, and 7820 ft in the 2023 IdahoAlpineZone trip report; not used. The only dated history is 1907 and the 2022 fire. No staffing source found. Access and drive/trail details come from one hiking trip report; the site itself has not been checked on the ground, and no source describes lookout remains.
